name: Ozow

initiate.endpoint: POST https://pay.ozow.com/ (form-post redirect) OR POST https://api.ozow.com/postpaymentrequest (REST, ApiKey header)

status.webhook_verification: NotifyUrl POST carries a Hash. Recompute: concat notification field VALUES in NOTIFICATION order (differs from request order) + PrivateKey, lowercase the WHOLE string, SHA512 hex, compare case-insensitively. Redirect return is NOT trustworthy alone — verify server-side.

credentials_required.label: Site Code
credentials_required.note: identifies the site; sent in the request body/query and is the first value in the HashCheck concatenation

credentials_required.label: Private Key
credentials_required.note: SHA512 salt — NEVER transmitted; appended to the concatenation before lowercasing + hashing

credentials_required.label: API Key
credentials_required.note: sent as the HTTP 'ApiKey' header for REST calls (postpaymentrequest, GetTransactionByReference)

credentials_required.label: Environment
credentials_required.note: test → stagingapi.ozow.com + IsTest=true; live → pay.ozow.com (redirect) + api.ozow.com (REST). Separate credentials per environment.

test_credentials.note: No instant self-serve sandbox — staging site + credentials are issued during onboarding. Staging host: stagingapi.ozow.com. Set IsTest="true".

sandbox.notes: IsTest=true + staging host shows a selection page where you choose the success/fail outcome (no real bank). ⚠️ Test transactions may NOT fire the NotifyUrl webhook — you must also test the redirect-return path. Confirm current staging webhook behaviour with Ozow.

pain_points.cause: Fields concatenated in the wrong order, wrong empty-field handling, Amount not '%.2f', IsTest sent as a boolean, or lowercasing only part of the string
pain_points.mitigation: Keep TWO hardcoded ordered field lists (request vs notification — they differ). Concatenate VALUES only (no separators, missing→''), append the RAW PrivateKey, then lowercase the WHOLE string before SHA512. Amount must be exactly 2dp; IsTest is the lowercase string 'true'/'false'. Lock it with a golden vector.

pain_points.problem: Notification hash uses a DIFFERENT field order than the request
pain_points.cause: Developers reuse the request field order to verify the inbound notification
pain_points.mitigation: Maintain a separate NOTIFICATION field order and recompute the hash with it. ⚠️ The exact notification order is UNVERIFIED here — confirm against live hub.ozow.com.

pain_points.problem: Trusting the redirect return as proof of payment
pain_points.cause: SuccessUrl redirect can be reached without a settled EFT
pain_points.mitigation: Treat the NotifyUrl POST (verified by hash) as authoritative and reconcile via GetTransactionByReference polling. Never fulfil on the redirect alone.

pain_points.problem: Test transactions never trigger the webhook
pain_points.mitigation: Test BOTH the redirect-return and webhook paths; drive reconciliation via polling in test.

pain_points.cause: Ozow ships REST + hand-rolled SHA512 only
pain_points.mitigation: Call REST directly and compute the HashCheck yourself with Node crypto. Community libs: omnipay-ozow (PHP), ozpay.

notes: South Africa only, ZAR only, instant EFT (bank redirect) — formerly i-Pay. Three credentials per site: SiteCode (public-ish), PrivateKey (SHA512 salt, never sent), ApiKey (REST header). Live onboarding is KYC-gated (business), not an instant sandbox. Refunds run through a SEPARATE Refunds API (GetToken bearer → POST refund with TransactionId + HashCheck, paid from the Ozow float); a refund reaching Complete maps to canonical 'refunded'. No dispute/chargeback status on Ozow (bank EFT). In ManishaPay the catalog currently gates refund=false, so the provider does not implement refund() yet.
